                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching its capacity limit: true
                when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                The hard limit of 50 owners per city still rejects the create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's customer
                code (the region-and-hash identity '<REGION>-<HASH8>'). 'UNKNOWN'
                when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birth date when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older, computed as the owner's age on the registration date.
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string

              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true

                (non-hard) duplicate of an existing owner: true when it shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but had a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean

                false.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<REGION>-<HASH8>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode and
                HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over
                the normalized telephone concatenated with the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A1B9C'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the
                last two digits of the registration date's fiscal year (the
                fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year
                in which it ends).
              type: string
              example: 'NSW-3F2A1B9C-M26'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching its capacity limit: true
                when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                The hard limit of 50 owners per city still rejects the create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's customer
                code (the region-and-hash identity '<REGION>-<HASH8>'). 'UNKNOWN'
                when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from the birth date when present:
                'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64, and 'SENIOR' at 65
                or older, computed as the owner's age on the registration date.
                Absent when no birth date was supplied.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                Whether this owner, at the time it was created, was a soft
                (non-hard) duplicate of an existing owner: true when it shared an
                existing owner's last name and postcode but had a different
                telephone, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner was found to softly
                duplicate (same last name and postcode, different telephone) at
                the time it was created. Absent when 'possibleDuplicate' is
                false.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A link to this owner's own resource, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                where id is the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether the owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true)
                while retaining the record.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

          maxLength: 255

        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'

          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string

          maxLength: 80

        telephone:

            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:

          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be

          type: string

              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which
                it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last
                name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263F2A1B9C7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where the email and
                household id segments are empty when absent. Two owners are
                treated as duplicates only when their whole identity keys match.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed, at the time this owner
                was created, sharing the same first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively). Excludes the owner itself.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, starting at 0. Gains 2 when an
                email is present, 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure spans at least one elapsed fiscal year (the
                registration date's fiscal year is earlier than the current
                fiscal year).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 derived from
                the owner's membership points: 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3
                for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when the owner's membershipLevel is 3 or more,
                otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality
                is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner was created on a day that had already reached
                the bulk-signup threshold: true when more than 80 owners had
                already been created for the owner's registration date at the
                time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                Whether the owner's city is approaching its capacity limit: true
                when the city already held between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive) at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
                The hard limit of 50 owners per city still rejects the create.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, the REGION segment of the owner's customer
                code (the region-and-hash identity '<REGION>-<HASH8>'). 'UNKNOWN'
                when no region could be resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the owner's
                locality/region via the fixed region-to-timezone table:
                NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane. Absent when no region could be
                resolved.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read: 'EMAIL'
                when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The owner's stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the
                country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in
                threes (e.g. '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays
                in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-

              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR

                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: >-
                A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the
                owner's customer code.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner (one of MR, MRS, MS,
            DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when the structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it is
            preferred. On read this carries the composed, normalized address (the
            normalized 'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized
            'addressLine2' appended when an 'addressLine2' was supplied).
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When
            present (non-blank) it is preferred over the flat 'address'. On
            create it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace collapsed, common
            street-type abbreviations expanded) and stored.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. When present it is normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) and appended
            to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: a leading '+' and country code are kept,
            otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is
            dropped from the national digits; spaces, dashes and brackets are
            stripped. The result must be a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be
            a syntactically valid address; the value is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted the server sets it to its current
            date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional birth date of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present it is used to derive the owner's 'ageBand'
            (computed as the owner's age on the registration date).
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must
            be a 4-digit value that is valid for the owner's city per the fixed
            city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne -> VIC
            3000-3099, Brisbane -> QLD 4000-4099). A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. The value is stored and returned as
            given.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag set on create to acknowledge that this owner
            intentionally shares a household with an existing owner (same last
            name and address). When true, the duplicate-household check is
            bypassed and the owner is created anyway.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: >-
                The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName' from the
                stored first and last names.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, formatted '<title> <lastName>' when a
                title was supplied, otherwise just the last name.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of the owner's first and last
                names, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member id
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted
                '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the region code
                derived from the owner's postcode, FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the business-day-adjusted registration date (the fiscal
                year starts on 1 July and is named by the calendar year in which
                it ends), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of
                SHA-256 over the normalized telephone concatenated with the last
                name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the
                digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW263F2A1B9C7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the owner's business-day-adjusted
                registration date, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and
                is named by the calendar year in which it ends, so a
                registration date on or after 1 July belongs to the following
                calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for owners that belong to the same
                household (same last name and address). It is assigned when an
                owner is created with 'sharesHousehold' true and is identical for
                every owner in that household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F2A1B9C4D5E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
